notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Added Demo
Endless mode now unlocks on completing the game
Crushed a couple controller bugs

notes.title: Version v1.01 is now live
notes.content:
It's time for Little Eye's first patch. This one includes various fixes and improvements suggested by the community (all 2 of his fans!). 

So without further ado:

- Added cursor when using mouse & keyboard input - this should help with control issues

- Mouse cursor is now confined to the game window - this one's for you, multiple monitors user!

- Fixed being able to bypass final boss' final phase - not cool

- Slightly reduced final boss' final phase difficulty

- Boss lasers now have a different look for clarity

- Fixed some issues that would leave the game hanging


Aaand that's all for now! Stay tuned for more updates.
